annotations.title: Get consensus odds for a card

description: The UFCalendar consensus odds line for every bout on one card, in card order: the current line, the opening line, the closing line once a bout is settled, and how far the market moved since opening, each with how many sportsbooks backed it. Unpriced bouts are listed with nulls. Book identities are never exposed. Information only, not betting advice.
